needed.evidence: The area to the left of the road is an unpaved, uneven strip with no formal sidewalk, forcing pedestrians to walk in a hazardous area.
needed.suggestion: Construct a formal, paved sidewalk on the left side of the road to provide a safe and accessible path for pedestrians.
